reuse.why: The new linkBankSyncAccount helper is used by all six providers including Fintegra, but the take-over step re-writes the unlink column reset instead of sharing it with unlinkAccount, and the Fintegra download is a fresh copy of the per-provider download functions rather than a shared one.

duplication.why: The upgrade/create/sync/notify flow is de-duplicated well, but the diff adds a copy of unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount null-reset and another near-copy of the Akahu/PluggyAI download function (plus a duplicated export line).

placement.why: Linking helpers live in accounts/app.ts and the download in sync.ts as the tree does, though the closed-account rule is folded into a guard named ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked.

scope.why: Mostly on task, but it trims existing explanatory comments in the Enable Banking link, adds a duplicated `export type * from './fintegra'` and leaves an unformatted long call.

maintainability.why: The single link definition is a clear win, but the guard now mixes three rules (closed target, duplicate link, take-over with unlinking) under a misleading name and the unlink field list exists twice.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked unlinks the holder with its own db.updateAccount null-reset instead of going through the unlink logic in unlinkAccount

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts reshapes the Akahu download body (destructuring instead of the retVal block, dropped 'error' branch) rather than sharing it

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains the replaceExistingLink parameter, a closed-upgrading-account branch and a take-over unlink branch; all six provider link functions still route through it and linkBankSyncAccount
